scope: Cargo files, README.md, src/, runtime/, scripts/, tests/ and assets/ exported from the exact pinned local commit. Repository docs and CI files are excluded.
verification: Every exported blob and executable bit was checked against the exact local Git tree. Archive timestamps and owner IDs are normalized; archive SHA-256 and contents were verified locally.
publication_boundary: The legacy published_core_* keys name the intended release commit/tree. Remote publication was not verified: this commit is currently local and must be pushed before remote dependency acquisition. Deterministic source bundle and dependency manifests only; GUI behavior is verified separately.
source_nar_verification: Nix nix-hash 2.18.1 --type sha256 --base64 over the complete exact Git export, excluding .git. The same method reproduced the existing GTK flake hash for the previous public core commit; this is a recursive NAR hash, distinct from archive_sha256. No Nix or Flatpak application build was run.
flatpak_sources_verification: Existing pinned update-flatpak-cargo-sources.sh --update and --check both passed. All 199 registry package archives/checksums match Cargo.lock; the Git entry and offline source configuration name the exact core pin. A temporary command-scoped Git URL mapping read the same local core commit during generation; output retains the public repository URL. No remote publication or Flatpak runtime build is claimed.
